mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 0.5% signals robust construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when HOUST rises by ≥0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% indicates aggressive rate tightening that compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days due to reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth >0.1% and UNRATE decline >0.1% in the prior month signal labor market strength that boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 0.1% and UNRATE < -0.1% in prior month
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when PAYEMS rises ≥0.1% and UNRATE falls ≥0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, RSAFS growth >0.5% indicates strong consumer credit demand that fuels corporate revenue, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when RSAFS rises ≥0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO growth >0.5% in the prior month signals manufacturing output strength that correlates with rising corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when INDPRO rises ≥0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 300 indicates persistent inflation that triggers rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days through reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive in >45% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent HOUST growth >0.5% and RSAFS growth >0.5% in the prior month signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days through sustained economic momentum.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 0.5% and RSAFS > 0.5% in prior month
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise ≥0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In labor market tightness regimes, UNRATE below 3.5% signals reduced job search friction and wage growth that increases consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%.
